from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib,json,re,subprocess
task=Path("reports/T0008");freeze=json.loads((task/"review-r2-freeze/audit.json").read_text())
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()==freeze["head"]
for p,h in freeze["history_sha256"].items():assert sha(p)==h,p
accepted={}
for p in ("src/kmesh/logic/derivations.py","tests/test_derivations.py"):
    assert sha(p)==freeze["input_sha256"][p],p
    accepted[p]=sha(p)
base=json.loads((task/"planning-baseline.json").read_text())
for p,h in base["source_sha256"].items():
    if h is not None:assert sha(p)==h,p
docs=["README.md","docs/implementation_status.md","docs/handoffs/T0008-ground-derivations.md","reports/T0008/review-r2/review.md"]
links=0
for name in docs:
    p=Path(name);s=p.read_text()
    assert s.endswith("\n") and all(line.rstrip()==line for line in s.splitlines()),name
    for target in re.findall(r"\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)",s):
        if "://" in target or target.startswith("#"):continue
        assert (p.parent/target.split("#",1)[0]).resolve().exists(),(name,target)
        links+=1
s=Path(docs[2]).read_text()
assert "- 状态："+chr(96)+"accepted"+chr(96) in s
assert len(re.findall(r"^- \[x\] A[1-7]：",s,re.M))==7
assert "awaiting_review" not in Path(docs[0]).read_text()
assert "awaiting_review" not in Path(docs[1]).read_text()
subprocess.run(["git","diff","--check"],check=True)
changed=set(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--name-only"],text=True).splitlines())
assert changed=={"README.md","docs/decisions.md","docs/handoffs/T0007-relation-dag.md","docs/implementation_status.md"},changed
plan=json.loads((task/"planning-final-check/checks.json").read_text())
for p in ("docs/decisions.md","docs/handoffs/T0007-relation-dag.md"):assert sha(p)==plan["artifact_sha256"][p]
runs={}
for name in ("review-r2-freeze","review-r2-focused","review-r2-guards","review-r2-readme-order","review-r2-isolation-probe"):
    r=json.loads((task/name/"record.json").read_text())
    assert r["exit_code"]==0 and r["before"]["source_sha256"]==r["after"]["source_sha256"],name
    for stream in ("stdout","stderr"):assert sha(task/name/(stream+".txt"))==r[stream+"_sha256"],name
    runs[name]={k:r[k] for k in ("argv","exit_code","elapsed_s","started_at_utc","finished_at_utc")}
guard=json.loads((task/"review-r2-guards/guards.json").read_text())
assert [x["exit_code"] for x in guard["cases"]]==[0,1,1]
audit={"created_at_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"result":"PASS","task_status":"accepted","head":freeze["head"],"reviewer":"Codex + gpt-6-astra xhigh; non-author of Pi product/tests","accepted_files":accepted,"product_defect_found":False,"open_findings":[],"closed_findings":["R1 collection and import isolation","R2 discriminating matching fixtures and input boundaries","R3 README budget/order","R4 evidence corrections with historical limits"],"acceptance":{f"A{i}":"PASS" for i in range(1,8)},"A7_limits":"Current evidence independently verifiable; 1934 direct records matched independent oracle"],"historical_files_preserved":len(freeze["history_sha256"]),"closure_checks":{"git_diff_check":"PASS","strict_local_links":links,"text_hygiene":"PASS","product_and_tests_frozen":"PASS"},"record_clarifications":["Negative giant integer is 10**5000, parameter max_derivations; isolated JOIN has variables, ground fixture is separate","607 full regression is Pi execution; Codex independently ran focused/guards/collection/isolation","19 recorder hashes do not include handoff text; final document edit timing remains Pi self-report","RUN names can be supplemented; doc-check lacks git diff invocation, performed independently here","pi-r2-doc-check actual exit 0 at 2026-09-18T04:08:55Z"],"limits":["R1 move/reuse and unarchived operations remain historical limits","Pi reported status transition and final document-check timing deviations preserved","Only direct derivations accepted; full proofs/uniqueness/depth/motif/world audit remain unimplemented","No commit/push"],"artifact_sha256":{p:sha(p) for p in docs+["reports/T0008/review-r2-freeze/audit.json","reports/T0008/review-r2-guards/guards.json","reports/T0008/review-r2-isolation-probe/findings.json"]}}
(task/"review-r2/final-audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(audit,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print(f"PASS: accepted source/tests frozen; {len(freeze['history_sha256'])} historical files unchanged.")
print(f"PASS: {links} local links, final status, A1-A7 and diff/text hygiene.")
print("VERDICT: accepted; R1-R4 closed; historical limitations preserved; no commit/push.")
